title: Formal Reporting Verbs: Állít, Megjegyez & Hangsúlyoz

sections.title: Precision in Reporting
sections.content: In news discourse and formal writing, *mondja* is replaced by nuanced verbs: *állítja* (claims), *megjegyzi* (remarks), *bejelenti* (announces), and *hangsúlyozza* (emphasizes). These verbs anchor the subordinate clause with the demonstrative *azt* or *arról*.

items.spanish: A szóvivő hangsúlyozta, hogy a tárgyalások sikeresek voltak.
items.english: The spokesperson emphasized that the negotiations were successful.

items.spanish: A miniszter bejelentette, hogy új program indul a fiataloknak.
items.english: The minister announced that a new program was launching for youth.

items.spanish: A szakértő megjegyezte, hogy a gazdasági növekedés stabil.
items.english: The expert remarked that economic growth was stable.
